fact: Zalthir retrieves the spider medallion from Xinaya's hand while she is still alive.
source_quote: Zalthir retrieved the spider medallion from Xinaya's bloated, fungal hand while she was still alive
subject: medallion retrieval

fact: Xinaya warns the party that those infected by the spores have only days to find a cure.
source_quote: The dying drow warned the party that those infected by the spores had only days to find a cure before sharing her fate
subject: Xinaya's warning

fact: Xinaya states that it is too late to cure her.
source_quote: It is too late for me
subject: Xinaya

fact: Gyrgum determines that lesser restoration cannot cure Xinaya.
source_quote: Gyrgum considered lesser restoration and even revivify, but she was too far gone
subject: Gyrgum considers lesser restoration

fact: Gyrgum considers using revivify on Xinaya.
source_quote: Gyrgum briefly considers revivify as well, though he has no third-level spell slots remaining
subject: Gyrgum considers revivify

fact: Only magic on the scale of a wish might restore someone with Xinaya's level of fungal corruption.
source_quote: only magic on the scale of a wish might have restored her
subject: cure for spore infection

fact: Thorin consults with Dawnbringer regarding Xinaya's request for death.
source_quote: Thorin consulted quietly with Dawnbringer, and together they granted her the merciful death she had begged for
subject: Dawnbringer consultation

fact: Thorin describes his bond with Dawnbringer as a partnership or marriage.
source_quote: Thorin described his bond with the blade as a marriage he had not requested but intended to honor
subject: Dawnbringer

fact: Thorin grants Xinaya a merciful death at her request to end her suffering.
source_quote: Thorin, wielding Dawnbringer and consulting with the sentient blade, delivers a mercy kill to Xinaya at her own request to end her suffering
subject: Xinaya mercy kill

fact: Xinaya is dead, having been granted a merciful death by Thorin.
source_quote: together they granted her the merciful death she had begged for
subject: Xinaya

fact: The party discovers the remains of their former companion Sarith.
source_quote: The party discovers the remains of their former companion Sarith
subject: Sarith

fact: Sarith's head had exploded during his transformation into a spore servant.
source_quote: whose head had exploded during his transformation into a spore servant
subject: Sarith

fact: Sarith's death confirms the corruption that had been affecting him.
source_quote: Sarith's fate removes any remaining uncertainty about the corruption that had been affecting him
subject: Sarith corruption
